about: Monster Defense: the words its questions use. first: a picture whose first letter makes its usual sound (Which letter does it start with?). read: short words to read (Find the word ...). Each has a picture (assets/games/words/<word>.webp) and Pencil's lines (assets/voice/md_first_<word>, md_word_<word>); tools/games/cut_art.py and tools/voice/generate_voice.py --app make them from this list.
